backstory.halgventmod.craftsman.desc: A jack of all trades, rotting behind the city walls.
backstory.halgventmod.deserter.desc: A coward who fled the battlefield to save his worthless life.
backstory.halgventmod.fisher.desc: A simple fisherman burning his life away before the unconquerable elements.
backstory.halgventmod.hunter.desc: A patient, stubborn huntsman ready to bring down any beast.
backstory.halgventmod.jester.desc: A kind-hearted joker who plunges people into tragedy with a single word.
backstory.halgventmod.mercenary.desc: A free soldier walking toward his dream, sword in hand.
backstory.halgventmod.minstrel.desc: A merry actor and poet who pleases wealthy ladies.
backstory.halgventmod.noble.desc: A man of honour and glory amid the crowds of turmoil.
backstory.halgventmod.peasant.desc: A slave of fields and mills who bravely weathers the blows of fate.
backstory.halgventmod.pilgrim.desc: A devout wanderer with no power even over his own fate.
backstory.halgventmod.savage.desc: Lord of his own free land, ancient in manners and customs.

block.halgventmod.aging_cask.lore: Pour in wine, mead, cider, a spirit or a tincture (up to 16 bottles of one drink): it gets better every week, faster in a cellar. E with a bottle or vessel pours in, with an empty one draws. Right-click opens it. Break it and it spills.
block.halgventmod.apple_leaves.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.baking_oven.lore: A big 2×2×2 oven: stone hearth, brick vault, chimney. Firewood and a flint fire it up. E with dough or a raw pie to bake, an empty hand takes it out. It also dries malt.
block.halgventmod.bloomery.lore: A massive clay shaft furnace to smelt ore: 2×2 at the base, 3 blocks high. E with an empty hand opens it (ore, charcoal, flux, "Smelt"), or E with ore, charcoal and flux to charge it, a flint and steel to start: work the bellows and hold the heat. Out comes a bloom; copper, tin, silver and silver-bearing lead run molten into a crucible (put one in the window).
block.halgventmod.blueberry_bush.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.bog_silt.lore: Silt with lumps of bog ore, placed by builders. Left-click with a shovel to dig ore: each stroke costs stamina. A dug-out bed gathers ore again over a few days.
block.halgventmod.brine_barrel.lore: Raw meat or fish and a salt per piece — salted in two days.
block.halgventmod.carpenter_bench.lore: E opens the bench: pick a product, lay out planks and the rest, "Make" works through its steps with tools from your inventory.
block.halgventmod.casting_table.lore: A table of moulding sand that serves again and again. E opens it: pick a casting or ingots, "Cast" pours the mould from a crucible of molten metal you carry (melt the charge in the forge).
block.halgventmod.cementation_box.lore: A two-block furnace with a clay box for steel. E with an empty hand opens it: iron ingots and charcoal (two per ingot), "Seal" (a clay ball), "Light" (a flint and steel). The charcoal smoulders and the iron takes up carbon; open it after a day and a half for steel, too long and it turns brittle.
block.halgventmod.chamomile_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.charcoal_pile.lore: A charcoal burner's clamp. E with firewood stacks it (up to 16), E with a shovel covers it with the earth around (strokes cost stamina), a flint and steel lights it. It smoulders a day: open early and you get brands, late and you get ash.
block.halgventmod.cherry_leaves.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.chopping_block.lore: E with a log sets it on the block, E with an axe splits it into firewood (strike with a full swing), an empty hand takes it off.
block.halgventmod.cinnabar_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.clay_barrel.lore: Clay, a bucket of water and sand or grog (one to three) — E with an empty hand kneads. Shift + E takes the potter's clay.
block.halgventmod.copper_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.cranberry_bush.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.cupel.lore: A porous dish of ash and bone meal. E with a crucible of molten silver-bearing lead pours it in (or E with an ingot), a flint and steel fires it: the lead burns off and the silver flashes as a bead. Take it off in time.
block.halgventmod.dome_kiln.lore: A clay dome over a firebox, 2×2×2 blocks, stoked through the mouth in front. Ten pieces. Right-click opens the kiln: greenware, firewood, a flint; heat is set by draft: draft 1 for a minute, then 3–4 (600–850°). Low draft while hot smokes burnished ware black. It also roasts ore and calcines lead to ash and bone to bone ash.
block.halgventmod.drying_rack.lore: E with wet leather or a pelt stretches it. Dries in a day in summer, four in winter. Rain gets in the way.
block.halgventmod.drying_shelf.lore: E with greenware to set it drying. A day under a roof; faster under the sky but it cracks; rain soaks it.
block.halgventmod.fermenting_barrel.lore: Pour in must; honey, herbs, berries are extras. Ferments for days; draw with a bottle. Ferments sealed; too long and it is vinegar. Alchemy: spirit, vinegar or water + a reagent make balms, theriac, essences, paint, vitriol (see the book). Right-click opens the barrel.
block.halgventmod.fleshing_beam.lore: E with a hide in hand lays it down; E with the fleshing knife, scraper or salt works it.
block.halgventmod.glass_furnace.lore: A 2×2×2 brick hood furnace with working holes. Firewood and a flint bring it to 1250°. Sand, potash, flux and cullet are the batch; from 1100° it melts into glass. Blow at a hole with a pipe; the work is annealed in the chamber. Right-click opens the furnace.
block.halgventmod.gold_placer.lore: River sand with grains of gold, placed by builders by the water. E with a pan to wash it. The placer runs poor and is washed rich again over a few days.
block.halgventmod.gold_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.grape_vine.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.hearth.lore: Firewood and a flint make a fire. A pot goes on top, or meat is grilled right on the coals. Shovel out the ash.
block.halgventmod.iron_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.kitchen_table.lore: E with an empty hand shows recipes. Food, water and salt go on the board, an empty hand kneads. Dough and pies are made here.
block.halgventmod.lavender_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.lead_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.leather_table.lore: E opens the table: pick a pattern, put leather or cloth into the slots, "Cut" with a knife or shears, then "Sew" with a needle.
block.halgventmod.limestone_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.lingonberry_bush.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.loom.lore: Two blocks tall. E with weights hangs them, E with yarn sets the warp, E with the shuttle weaves, an empty hand takes the cloth off.
block.halgventmod.mint_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.mortar.lore: A heavy bronze mortar and pestle. E with gold ore, cinnabar, a dried herb or a bone to put it in (up to 4), an empty hand to pound in rhythm. You get crushed ore, red paint, herb powder or bone meal.
block.halgventmod.nettle_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.olive_leaves.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.orange_leaves.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.pear_leaves.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.plum_leaves.lore: For builders. The fruit ripens by itself (except in winter); E with an empty hand picks it when ripe.
block.halgventmod.pottery_wheel.lore: E with potter's clay to put it on, an empty hand to sit at the wheel and shape a vessel voxel by voxel.
block.halgventmod.quern.lore: E with wheat, rye or sherds to fill, an empty hand to turn. Don't rush — the grain spills.
block.halgventmod.retort.lore: A clay flask with a long beak and a receiver. Put it over a fire (hearth, campfire). E puts things in, an empty hand takes what is done, Shift + E takes back what you put in. Right-click opens it.
block.halgventmod.sawhorse.lore: E with a log lays it on, E with a saw rips it into planks, an empty hand takes an unsawn log off.
block.halgventmod.sharpening_wheel.lore: A grinding wheel the anvil needs for sharpening. E with a dull blade or tool to touch it up (not past its old wear: beyond that only reforging helps).
block.halgventmod.silver_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.skep.lore: Place it near flowers: a swarm settles in during spring or summer. It stores honey; in winter the bees eat it — leave them some.
block.halgventmod.sluice.lore: A trough of running water. E with crushed ore to fill it (up to 4), E with a pan to wash. Quicksilver in your inventory catches the fine gold too, using up a vial.
block.halgventmod.smith_anvil.lore: E opens the anvil: pick a piece, lay out metal and the rest, "Forge" works through the steps with hammer and tongs from your inventory. A lit forge must be nearby.
block.halgventmod.smithy_forge.lore: The smith's hearth, fired with charcoal or coal. E with coal feeds it, a flint and steel lights it, an empty hand opens it, Shift + E works the bellows. An anvil nearby needs it. In its window: the crucible, charge, alloys and melting.
block.halgventmod.smoking_hook.lore: Hang it above a hearth: meat and fish get smoked. Herbs and mushrooms dry on it.
block.halgventmod.sound_emitter.lore: An invisible source of place sounds, for administration. Hold it to see sources; E at a source to set it up.
block.halgventmod.st_johns_wort_plant.lo: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.still.lore: E on a hearth puts it on the fire (or place it above a campfire). Pour in beer, wine, cider or mead; four bottles make one spirit — into a bottle or an amphora. Right-click opens the still.
block.halgventmod.tanning_vat.lore: E with a water bucket fills it; E with ash, bark, alum and salt or fat makes the bath; E with a hide sinks it. Over a fire it boils. By an anvil it serves as a quench tub: water, brine (water with salt) or fat.
block.halgventmod.thyme_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.tin_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.
block.halgventmod.wine_press.lore: E with apples, pears, grapes, cherries, plums or berries to fill, an empty hand to press, a bottle, amphora or jug to draw the must.
block.halgventmod.wormwood_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.yarrow_plant.lore: For builders. E with a knife, sickle or scythe at a grown plant cuts the herb; a cut plant grows back by itself in a day or two (not in winter). Can't be broken in adventure mode.
block.halgventmod.zinc_vein.lore: An ore vein, placed by builders. Left-click with a pickaxe to mine: each blow costs stamina, a blow on the spark counts twice. The vein runs poor and recovers over a few days.

gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.cider.how: Apple or pear must from the press. 4 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.essence.how: Spirit + herb powder (from a mortar), 3 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.essence.serv: Like a tea of that herb, but three times as long.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.mead.how: Honey must from a pot: honey and water. 6 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.potash.how: Water + hearth ash (one per bottle), 2 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.potash.serve: Potash, for glass. Scoop out by hand.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.theriac.serv: Antidote: clears poison, wither, food poisoning.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.tincture.how: Spirit from the still and an addition: honey, herbs or berries. 3 days.

gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.verdigris.se: 2 verdigris per bottle. Scoop out by hand.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.vitriol.how: Water (bucket, jug, bottle) + roasted copper ore, 3 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.vitriol.serv: Vitriol, for sublimate. Scoop out by hand.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.white_lead.h: Vinegar + lead ash (one per bottle), seal for 2 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.white_lead.s: White lead: 2 white dye per bottle. Scoop out by hand.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.wine.how: Must from the press: grapes, cherries, plums, berries. 4 days.
gui.halgventmod.barrel.book.wound_balm.s: +2 hearts and Regeneration I for 30 s.

gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book.bog.how: 3 bog ore per charge; roasted is better.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book.copper.how: 2 ore per charge; unroasted copper is worse. The copper runs into a crucible.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book.iron.how: 2 ironstone per charge. The bloom is beaten into iron on the anvil.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book.lead.how: 1 galena per charge. It runs into a crucible; while molten, E the cupel with it to part the silver.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book.silver.how: 3 ore per charge. The silver runs into a crucible.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book.tin.how: 2 tinstone per charge. The tin runs into a crucible.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.book_hint: Each charge takes %s charcoal and flux; up to %s charges per smelt.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.coal: Coal: the metal comes out worse
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.empty: The furnace is empty. Put in ore of one kind, charcoal and flux.
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.not_enough: Not enough: a charge takes %s ore and %s charcoal

gui.halgventmod.bloomery.to_crucible: Runs into the crucible molten: lift it with tongs
gui.halgventmod.bloomery.unroasted: Roasted: %s of %s; roast it in a pottery kiln
gui.halgventmod.carpenter_bench.group.pa: Handles and shafts for the smith

gui.halgventmod.cask.empty: Empty: pour in wine, mead, cider, a spirit or a tincture. Beer is not aged. Top up with the same drink: the quality blends.
gui.halgventmod.cask.exposed: Under the open sky: nothing ages
gui.halgventmod.cask.house: Under a roof: a step every %s days (faster in a cellar)

gui.halgventmod.cementation.done: The steel is done; don't overdo it.

gui.halgventmod.forge.book.brass.how: 2 copper ingots, 2 calamine and a clay ball for a lid: without it the calamine burns off. Don't overheat: above 1040° the zinc goes up in smoke.
gui.halgventmod.forge.book.bronze.how: 9 copper ingots and 1 tin: a tenth tin. More tin and it turns brittle, less and it stays soft.
gui.halgventmod.forge.book.gold.how: 5 gold dust make an ingot. Melt it in the hottest spot, with the bellows.
gui.halgventmod.forge.book.pewter.how: 4 tin ingots and 1 lead. It melts at the edge of the forge without the bellows.
gui.halgventmod.forge.book.pure.how: Copper, tin, lead, silver: one at a time, unmixed, for castings or back into ingots.
gui.halgventmod.forge.book.remelt.how: Set metal goes back into the forge in its crucible and is melted again. It won't get any better for it.
gui.halgventmod.forge.book_hint: A crucible holds up to %s ingots. Out of the forge the melt stays liquid %s s; lift it with tongs. Take the molten crucible to the casting table.
gui.halgventmod.forge.empty: The crucible is empty: charge it with ingots, gold dust or calamine.
gui.halgventmod.forge.no_alloy: Nothing will come: calamine only goes with copper
gui.halgventmod.forge.no_lid: Without a lid (a clay ball) the calamine burns off
gui.halgventmod.forge.only_lid: The crucible is lidded but empty: add a charge.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.anneal.how: Blown work goes into the lehr by itself, a minute. E with an empty hand takes what is annealed.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.anneal.serve: Taken out early it is brittle: ware breaks sooner, half the bottles and panes burst.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.blow.how: Choose the piece with the button, E with a blowpipe at the furnace from 1000°: gather, blow, marver.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.blow.serve: Bottles ×4, goblet, flask, window glass ×8. Badly done, it bursts into cullet.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.melt.how: Sand ×2 + potash (+ flux for clearer glass) into the batch, heat from 1100°.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.melt.serve: A portion in 30 s; cullet makes one twice as fast.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.potash.how: Hearth ash + water in a fermenting barrel, sealed for 2 days.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.potash.serve: Potash: scoop it out by hand.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.tint.how: A colourant in its slot, one per piece.
gui.halgventmod.glass.book.tint.serve: Verdigris: green; lead ash: crystal; bone ash: milk white; bog ore: brown; gold dust: ruby.
gui.halgventmod.glass.title: Glass
gui.halgventmod.hearth.grill_hint: E with meat or fish to lay it; E on a piece to flip it
gui.halgventmod.kitchen.title: Recipes
gui.halgventmod.map.draw.clear_confirm: All drawings on the map of this world and dimension will be lost. This cannot be undone.
gui.halgventmod.pattern.title: Patterns
gui.halgventmod.point.hint.circle: Scroll or arrows — radius · drag the handle on the edge · Shift+scroll — zoom
gui.halgventmod.point.hint.polygon: Drag corners · dot on a side — new corner · right-click a corner — remove · arrows — nudge
gui.halgventmod.point.spawn.tooltip: New characters can pick this place to start the game here.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.fish_soup.how: Mostly fish. Better with onion and herbs.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.fish_soup.serve: One portion per fish. Ladle into a bowl.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.herbal_tea.how: Herbs only, nothing else. Better with honey.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.herbal_tea.serve: Two bottles per bunch of herbs.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.hint: Pour in water (E a bucket or jug), put food into the pot slots and light the fire. At medium heat it cooks in about %s s. When the stir bar turns red press Stir (you need a ladle) or it scorches. Ladle the result with E and a bowl or bottle.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.honey_must.serve: Two bottles per honey — for the fermenting barrel, it becomes mead.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.meat_stew.how: Mostly meat (raw, salted, dried). Salt, herbs, garlic are seasoning: tastier.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.meat_stew.serve: One portion per main ingredient. Ladle into a bowl.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.mushroom_soup.se: One portion per main ingredient. Ladle into a bowl.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.porridge.how: Grain or flour: wheat, rye, barley, oats — named after the grain there is most of. Milk makes it richer, honey sweeter.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.porridge.serve: One portion per main ingredient. Ladle into a bowl.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.potato_stew.how: Potatoes are the only vegetable (onion and garlic do not count).
gui.halgventmod.recipes.potato_stew.serv: One portion per main ingredient. Ladle into a bowl.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.title: What to cook
gui.halgventmod.recipes.vegetable_soup.h: Mixed vegetables: turnip, cabbage, carrot, beetroot, beans. Three or more different bases taste better.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.vegetable_soup.s: One portion per main ingredient. Ladle into a bowl.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.wort.how: Malt: pale, amber or dark — named after the darkest. Herbs make it spiced, honey makes it honeyed.
gui.halgventmod.recipes.wort.serve: Two bottles per malt — for the fermenting barrel.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book.bone.serve: Sal ammoniac in the receiver, bone ash in the flask.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book.pyrite.how: Unroasted copper ore into the flask, the retort over a fire.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book.pyrite.serve: Sulphur in the receiver, roasted ore in the flask.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book.sublimate.ho: Quicksilver into the flask, vitriol as the additive.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book.sublimate.se: Sublimate, a blade poison; the quicksilver vial is left.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book.sulfur.serve: Flowers of sulphur, for sulphur balm.
gui.halgventmod.retort.book_hint: The vapour settles in the receiver, the rest stays in the flask.
gui.halgventmod.retort.source_heat: Fire under the retort: heat %s. Heat 3 is faster, but some of the vapour goes up in smoke.
gui.halgventmod.retort.source_none: No fire under the retort: put it on a hearth or over a campfire.
gui.halgventmod.retort.state_empty: Put in something to sublime (see the book)
gui.halgventmod.retort.state_full: The receiver or residue is full: take it
gui.halgventmod.retort.state_hot: Subliming, but too hot: some goes up in smoke
gui.halgventmod.retort.state_needs_addit: Needs an additive: vitriol for quicksilver
gui.halgventmod.retort.title: Retort
gui.halgventmod.sawing.crooked: The cut wandered: that plank is an offcut
gui.halgventmod.sawing.hint: Left click or Space presses on the push · the mouse steers the saw
gui.halgventmod.sawing.jam: The saw jammed: press only on the push
gui.halgventmod.sawing.knot: The knot jerked the saw: be precise in knots
gui.halgventmod.sawing.title: Sawhorse
gui.halgventmod.sawing.wrong: The saw binds: that's the return stroke

gui.halgventmod.sewing.title: Sewing: %s
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.bellows_hint: Left click works the bellows, no faster than twice a second. Right click adds charcoal.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.bellows_hint_: Coal in the furnace: the metal will be worse. Left click bellows, right click charcoal.
Short of flux: slag will stay. Left click bellows, right click charcoal.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.bend_hint: Grab at the mark (left click) and follow the curve.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.blow_hint: Hold left click to blow, below the red line; bubble in the green zone: right click.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.consolidate_h: Strike the brown slag spots: left click to swing and strike. Enter when done.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.cupel_baked: The litharge baked: it took silver with it
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.cupel_hint: Space works the bellows: keep the heat in the band. Hold left click and push the litharge to the rim before it bakes.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.cupel_late: Too late: the silver burns away
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.cupel_status: Lead burnt off %s%%, litharge skimmed %s, baked %s
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.cut_hint: Move the chisel with the mouse, left click strikes. Three blows on a mark.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.draw_hint: Hold left click over a spot to swing, release to strike. Enter when done.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.forge_hint: %s Space puts it in the forge and takes it out.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.gather_hint: Hold left click to gather; keep turning with the mouse left and right; let go in the green zone.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.gild_fire_hin: Hold left click to bring it closer to the fire, release to lift it. Keep the heat in the green.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.gild_paint_hi: Hold left click and paint the pattern. Enter to go to the fire.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.glass_furnace: %s Space reheats it in the glory hole.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.glass_in_furn: In the glory hole… space takes it out
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.grind_hint: The mouse slides the blade over the wheel, hold left click to press (longer is harder, but heats it), right click pours water. Enter when done.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.in_forge: In the forge… left click works the bellows, space takes it out
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.melt_hint: The mouse moves the crucible into the heat (right) and out, left click works the bellows, right click skims dross. Pour at %s–%s°.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.mint_hint: Hold left click to swing; release when the die is over the blank.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.pan_clod_lost: A clay clod with gold went over the rim!
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.pan_hint: Space scoops water. Circle the mouse (not too fast or it slops), hold left click to pour off the rim. Right click flicks out a stone, breaks a clod, picks a nugget. Enter when done.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.pan_lost: A grain went over the rim!
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.pan_status: Washed %s%%, gold in the pan %s%%, water %s%%
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.pour_hint: Hold left click to tip the crucible. A steady stream; stop at the mark.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.pour_status: Mould %s%%, the melt stays liquid %s s more
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.punch_hint: Left click when the punch is over the mark.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.quench_hint: Left click to dip at cherry-orange, hold and move up and down.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.quench_wait: Wait for the colour: %s. Left click to dip
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.raise_hint: Left click raises (lighter is deeper), right click planishes. Enter when done.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.rivet_hint: First blow heavy, second moderate; strike when it stands straight.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.spin_hint: Move the mouse left and right: keep the speed in the green zone. Too slow it sags, too fast it wobbles.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.spin_sheet_hi: Spin the sheet with the mouse left and right: keep the speed in the green zone.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.stamp_hint: Left click when the pestle is down (green).
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.stamp_status: Handful %s of %s, pounded %s%%, off the beat %s
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.striker_aim: Point your hammer where to strike
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.striker_idle: The striker waits: this step needs no striker
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.temper_hint: The mouse moves the heat under the piece. Left click takes it off.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.upset_hint: A blow left of centre leans it right: straighten it with blows from the other side.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.weave_hint: Left click the rings to link through, then rivet in the green.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.weld_hint: Right click for flux. Heat to white, left click on the beat.
gui.halgventmod.smith_work.wire_hint: Hold left click to draw, let go before the red. Right click anneals.

item.halgventmod.alum.lore: White crystals found in calcite. Two handfuls and salt in a water vat make the alum bath.
item.halgventmod.amber_malt.lore: Into a pot with water for amber beer wort.
item.halgventmod.amphora.lore: Sixteen measures of water or eight bottles of one drink: drop a bottle onto it, draw with an empty bottle. In your inventory, right-click the amphora onto a jug or cup to pour the drink into it.
item.halgventmod.argentiferous_lead.lore: Lead smelted from galena with a little silver dissolved in it. The silver is parted on a cupel: the lead burns off to litharge, the silver stays.
item.halgventmod.armorial.lore: A book of banners. Right-click to open.
item.halgventmod.ash.lore: Right-click a burning campfire with a shovel. Three handfuls in a water vat make lye for liming.
item.halgventmod.axe_handle.lore: Thick at the eye, a slim neck and a knob at the end: for an axe, a maul, a war hammer. Goes to the smithy.
item.halgventmod.backpack.lore: Worn on the back. While worn, lets you carry more.
item.halgventmod.barbute.lore: A closed helmet reaching down to the neck, with a narrow opening for the face. It is often enamelled.
item.halgventmod.bark.lore: Right-click a log with an axe. Four pieces in a water vat make the tanning liquor.
item.halgventmod.barley.lore: Grain. In a pot — barley porridge. Right-click farmland to sow; wild barley turns up in grass.
item.halgventmod.bascinet.lore: A pointed helmet drawn down over the temples and the nape. Only the face is left bare.
item.halgventmod.bascinet_half.lore: A low bascinet with an open face. It guards the crown and the back of the head, but not the temples.
item.halgventmod.beans.lore: Not eaten raw — only in a pot. Right-click farmland to plant.
item.halgventmod.bear_hide.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.bee_smoker.lore: E at a hive smokes it: the bees calm down for half a minute, so the combs can be cut unstung.
item.halgventmod.beer.lore: Weak and filling, quenches thirst well. Drunk fresh — sours within a week. Cures a hangover.
item.halgventmod.beeswax.lore: Left from the combs. Dresses leather and oils leather goods.
item.halgventmod.belt_lantern.lore: Hangs from the belt and gives light.
item.halgventmod.berry_juice.lore: Berries, water and a bottle — at a kitchen table. Quenches thirst very well.
item.halgventmod.berry_pie.lore: A sweet pie from the oven.
item.halgventmod.birch_bolete.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.blowpipe.lore: A long iron tube. E with it at a hot glass furnace to gather glass and blow the piece chosen in the furnace window.
item.halgventmod.blueberry.lore: A forest berry. Bruises and spoils quickly.
item.halgventmod.bog_iron_ore.lore: Brown lumps of limonite from the bottom of peat bogs, the iron ore of the lowlands and coast. It is dug with shovels, dried and roasted in a pottery kiln before smelting.
item.halgventmod.boiled_leather.lore: Tanned leather boiled until hard as horn. For gauntlets and brigandines.
item.halgventmod.bone_ash.lore: Bone calcined white in a kiln or left over in a retort. With honey in spirit it makes theriac, the antidote.
item.halgventmod.brace.lore: Drills at a carpenter's bench: circle the mouse clockwise. Too fast and the bit wanders; keep the pace near the end or it blows out the back. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.brass_buckle.lore: A golden buckle for armour straps and belts.
item.halgventmod.brass_fittings.lore: Cast mounts and edgings that trim noble brigandines, parade cuirasses and scabbards.
item.halgventmod.brass_ingot.lore: Copper heated with calamine in a closed crucible. Golden and malleable: for buckles, fittings and armour trim.
item.halgventmod.bream.lore: A river fish. Grilled on the coals.
item.halgventmod.brick_mould.lore: E at a barrel of kneaded clay moulds a raw brick.
item.halgventmod.bronze_clasp.lore: A cast cloak or belt clasp. Goes to the sewing table.
item.halgventmod.bronze_ingot.lore: Copper alloyed with tin, harder and more ringing than copper. Bells, mortars, cauldrons and clasps are cast from bronze.
item.halgventmod.burnt_food.lore: Left too long on the fire. Edible, barely; burns in a hearth.
item.halgventmod.cabbage.lore: A juicy head: eases thirst a little too. Right-click farmland to plant.
item.halgventmod.carding_comb.lore: Hold right-click to comb a handful of flax or a tuft of wool from your inventory into fibre.
item.halgventmod.cervelliere.lore: A plain iron skullcap shaped to the head. Light and unobtrusive, it hides under a hood.
item.halgventmod.cervelliere_scaled.lore: A cervelliere of iron scales riveted to a leather cap. It fits closer than a forged one and is held by a chin strap.
item.halgventmod.chain.lore: A forged chain of welded links, for flails, kettle hooks and gates.
item.halgventmod.chamomile.lore: Cut from a chamomile plant. Tea: clears nausea and food poisoning, Regeneration I for 8 s.
item.halgventmod.chanterelle.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.cheese.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.chisel.lore: Cuts mortises at a carpenter's bench: left click taps, right click strikes hard. A hard blow near the edge splits the wood along the grain. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.cider.lore: Light, made of apples. Improves in an aging cask.
item.halgventmod.cinnabar.lore: A blood-red stone. Roasted, it gives up quicksilver; ground to powder in a mortar it makes the best red paint.
item.halgventmod.clay_bowl.lore: E at a pot of cooked food to ladle it. Stays in hand after eating.
item.halgventmod.clay_crucible.lore: A thick-walled little pot for molten metal, up to ten ingots. Set it in the forge, charge it in the forge window and melt; take the molten metal (lifted with tongs) to the casting table. Emptied, it may crack.
item.halgventmod.clay_cup.lore: One measure of water or a drink: right-click water to fill, right-click to drink. A jug or an amphora can fill it: right-click it onto the cup in your inventory.
item.halgventmod.clay_jug.lore: Four measures of water or four bottles of a drink: right-click water to fill, right-click to drink. Drop a bottle onto it or fill it at a still, barrel or press, or pour it from an amphora (right-click the amphora onto the jug). It fills a cup in turn. Full of water it does for a bucket.
item.halgventmod.clay_pot.lore: In the inventory drop food onto it — inside it spoils half as fast, under wax a quarter. Right-click to take out. An empty one goes on a hearth to cook in; it wears out and cracks.
item.halgventmod.coin_crona.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.coin_die.lore: A coin die, the right to strike coin. It is issued by the treasury, not forged. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.coin_gulden.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.coin_marka.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.coin_taler.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.cooked_venison.lore: Filling, but salty — makes you thirsty.
item.halgventmod.copper_ingot.lore: An ingot of red copper. Kettles and vessels are forged from it, and with tin or calamine it becomes bronze or brass.
item.halgventmod.copper_ore.lore: Green malachite and golden copper pyrite. The pyrite is roasted long before smelting, or the copper comes out brittle.
item.halgventmod.cranberry.lore: A bog berry; keeps longer than others.
item.halgventmod.crushed_gold_ore.lore: Quartz pounded to sand in a mortar. Wash it with a pan at a sluice: the heavy gold stays at the bottom.
item.halgventmod.cullet.lore: Shards of broken and burst glass. In the furnace they melt twice as fast as a batch: a portion of glass each.
item.halgventmod.dark_malt.lore: Into a pot with water for dark beer wort.
item.halgventmod.dough.lore: E at a fired oven bakes bread. With a filling at a kitchen table — a raw pie.
item.halgventmod.draw_plate.lore: A steel plate with a row of ever narrower holes to draw wire and gold thread through. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.dressed_fur.lore: Fur dressed with fat: soft and warm. For cloaks and lining.
item.halgventmod.dried_fish.lore: Salted fish dried on a hook. Never spoils, but makes you very thirsty.
item.halgventmod.dried_herbs.lore: Dried on a hook. Keep almost forever.
item.halgventmod.dried_mushrooms.lore: Dried on a hook. Good in a soup.
item.halgventmod.exquisite_mutton.lore: Mutton with spices from overseas and garlic. A dish for a noble table.
item.halgventmod.firewood.lore: Split logs. E at a hearth or oven to add them; they burn longer than planks.
item.halgventmod.flax.lore: Flax stalks. Comb them into fibre with the carding comb; tow falls out too.
item.halgventmod.flax_fiber.lore: Combed flax. Spin it into linen yarn with the spindle.
item.halgventmod.flax_seeds.lore: Found in the grass. Right-click farmland to sow flax.
item.halgventmod.flesh.lore: Fat and membrane from the inside of a hide. Boiled in a vat, it gives glue.
item.halgventmod.fleshing_knife.lore: E at the flesh patches of a hide on the beam scrapes them layer by layer. Aim at the patches and strike evenly, waiting for the swing: a clean spot or haste cuts the hide.
item.halgventmod.flux.lore: Crushed limestone. It goes into the furnace with the ore and charcoal so the waste rock runs off as slag instead of staying in the metal. Smiths also sprinkle it on iron to forge-weld.
item.halgventmod.fried_fish.lore: Bream or perch off the coals.
item.halgventmod.garlic.lore: A seasoning: for the pot and for mutton at a kitchen table. Right-click farmland to plant a clove.
item.halgventmod.glass_flask.lore: A blown flask with a narrow neck. Four measures of water or four bottles of a drink, like a jug. It breaks.
item.halgventmod.glass_goblet.lore: A blown goblet on a stem. One measure of water or a drink: right-click water to fill, right-click to drink; fill it from a jug, amphora or cask. It breaks like clay.
item.halgventmod.gold_dust.lore: Grains of gold washed out of river sand with a pan. Precious in itself: traders take it by weight.
item.halgventmod.gold_ingot.lore: Remelted gold dust. Guldens are struck from such ingots, gold thread is drawn from them and gilding made.
item.halgventmod.gold_ore.lore: White quartz with veins and specks of gold. Gold is not smelted from stone: the ore is pounded in a mortar, washed in a pan, and the finest grains are caught with quicksilver.
item.halgventmod.gold_pan.lore: A prospector's wooden pan. E at gold-bearing sand, or at a sluice holding crushed ore, to wash: rock it and pour off the light stuff, the heavy gold stays.
item.halgventmod.gold_ring.lore: A forged gold ring, a sign of wealth or betrothal.
item.halgventmod.gold_thread.lore: Gold drawn into the finest thread. The nobility and the church are embroidered with it.
item.halgventmod.goose.lore: A fat bird. Risky raw: grill it on the coals.
item.halgventmod.grape.lore: From the vineyards of Rosenmeier. A press makes berry juice for wine.
item.halgventmod.green_malt.lore: Dry it in an oven: briefly for pale malt, longer for amber, longer still for dark.
item.halgventmod.greenware.lore: A vessel from the wheel. A wet one dries on a shelf, a dry one is fired in a kiln. A failed one can be soaked back in the barrel.
item.halgventmod.grog.lore: Sherds ground on a quern. A better temper than sand: the ware cracks less often.
item.halgventmod.haft.lore: Straight, its end tapered for a socket: for a shovel, pick, hoe, fork or scythe. Goes to the smithy.
item.halgventmod.hammer.lore: Assembles pieces at a carpenter's bench: strike when the nail stands straight, and not too hard. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.herb_essence.lore: Spirit on herb powder. It works like a tea of that herb, but three times as long.
item.halgventmod.herb_powder.lore: Dried herb ground in a mortar. Steeped in spirit in a barrel it makes an essence that lasts three times as long as a tea.
item.halgventmod.herbal_tea.lore: Herbs steeped in a pot. Quenches thirst well.
item.halgventmod.herring.lore: A sea fish. Grilled on the coals or salted in a brine barrel.
item.halgventmod.hide_glue.lore: Binds layers of hardened leather. Gauntlets and brigandines need it.
item.halgventmod.honey.lore: Pressed from combs at a kitchen table. Never spoils. Sweetens a pot, fills a pastry.
item.halgventmod.honeycomb_full.lore: Cut from a hive with a knife. At a kitchen table they give honey and wax.
item.halgventmod.iron_bloom.lore: A spongy lump of iron with slag inside, what is left in the bloomery after smelting. The smith beats it on the anvil, driving the slag out, and gets iron ingots.
item.halgventmod.iron_ingot.lore: Beaten bloom iron, soft and tough. Nearly everything iron is forged from it, and steel is made of it in a cementation box.
item.halgventmod.iron_ore.lore: A heavy brown stone from the mountain mines. It holds more iron than bog ore, and the bloom comes out cleaner.
item.halgventmod.iron_wire.lore: Drawn through a draw plate. Mail rings are coiled from it.
item.halgventmod.key_ring.lore: Shift + E at a lock with the ring opens it if any key on it fits.
item.halgventmod.knife.lore: Cuts leather at the sewing table: "Cut" in the table window. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.ladle.lore: E at a pot stirs it before it scorches (it smokes and bubbles).
item.halgventmod.lavender.lore: Cut from a lavender plant. Tea: clears nausea, blindness and darkness, Regeneration I for 4 s.
item.halgventmod.lead_ash.lore: Lead calcined in a pottery kiln to yellow litharge. Poisonous. In vinegar it settles as white paint, white lead.
item.halgventmod.lead_ingot.lore: A heavy soft metal: temples are roofed with it, pipes, weights and seals are cast from it. Plenty of lead is left once the silver is parted.
item.halgventmod.lead_ore.lore: Shiny grey cubes of galena. Lead is smelted from it, and silver from that lead: nearly all silver is won this way.
item.halgventmod.lead_seal.lore: A lead bulla on a cord: it seals charters and bales.
item.halgventmod.leather_belt.lore: A lantern, a quiver and pouches hang from the belt.
item.halgventmod.leather_mallet.lore: E at dried leather on the rack softens it, making it better.
item.halgventmod.leather_scraps.lore: Left after cutting. Straps are cut from them.
item.halgventmod.leather_strap.lore: A strap, a tie, a loop. Bags, quivers and armour need them.
item.halgventmod.limed_hide.lore: Soaked in ash lye, the hair is slipping. Scrape it off on the beam.
item.halgventmod.linen_cloth.lore: A length off the loom. At the sewing table it becomes surcoats, aketons, a gambeson, gloves.
item.halgventmod.linen_yarn.lore: For the loom, as warp and weft. Makes thread too.
item.halgventmod.locksmith_kit.lore: For administration. E opens even locked ones, or hangs a padlock where there is none; Shift + E fits a mortise lock or removes any lock.
item.halgventmod.loom_weight.lore: Fired clay with a hole. Eight weights pull the warp of a loom taut.
item.halgventmod.mead.lore: Honey must fermented for a week. Better when aged.
item.halgventmod.meat_pie.lore: A filling pie from the oven.
item.halgventmod.meat_stew.lore: Rich meat with whatever was in the pot.
item.halgventmod.mercury.lore: Liquid silver in a sealed vial. It is used for gilding: gold is dissolved in it, brushed on bronze and driven off over a fire. Only it catches the finest gold when washing.
item.halgventmod.mint.lore: Cut from a mint plant. Tea: clears nausea, Speed I for 30 s.
item.halgventmod.mushroom_pie.lore: An oven pie with a mushroom filling.
item.halgventmod.must.lore: Juice from a press, beer wort or honey must from a pot. Pour it into a fermenting barrel.
item.halgventmod.nails.lore: Hand-forged nails with broad heads. They go to the carpenter's bench and into harness.
item.halgventmod.needle.lore: Sews at the sewing table: "Sew" in the table window, pierce when the needle is over a mark. The needle and thread are taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.nettle.lore: Cut from nettles. Tea: Vigour for 60 s, stamina recovers 1.3 times faster.
item.halgventmod.oats.lore: Grain. In a pot — oat porridge. Right-click farmland to sow; wild oats turn up in grass.
item.halgventmod.oil_lamp.lore: Fill it with fat or wax (drop it onto the lamp), right-click to light: you need a flint and steel or a torch on you.
item.halgventmod.olives.lore: Salted olives from the south. Never spoil.
item.halgventmod.onion.lore: Into the pot with potatoes and meat. Right-click farmland to plant.
item.halgventmod.padlock.lore: Hangs on a door or a chest. Anyone can take an unlocked padlock.
item.halgventmod.pale_malt.lore: Into a pot with water for beer wort.
item.halgventmod.parchment.lore: Finely scraped rawhide of a small beast. For letters, books and patterns.
item.halgventmod.pelt.lore: A clean hide without hair or flesh. Bark vat for tanned leather, alum vat for soft, the rack for rawhide.
item.halgventmod.perch.lore: A striped river fish. Grilled on the coals.
item.halgventmod.pewter_ingot.lore: Tin with lead, the metal of townsfolk's tableware: tankards, plates, spoons and pilgrim badges.
item.halgventmod.pewter_plate.lore: A flat cast plate for a townsman's table. E at a pot of cooked food to serve a portion; stays in hand after eating.
item.halgventmod.pewter_spoon.lore: A cast spoon with a twisted handle.
item.halgventmod.pewter_tankard.lore: A cast lidded tankard, a townsman's tableware. One measure of water or a drink: right-click water to fill, right-click to drink; fill it from a jug, amphora or cask. It doesn't break like clay.
item.halgventmod.pilgrim_badge.lore: A cast pewter badge with the saints, brought back from pilgrimage and worn on the hat.
item.halgventmod.plane.lore: Planes the blank at a carpenter's bench. Go with the grain and slow down over knots. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.porridge.lore: Grain boiled in a pot. With milk it is more filling.
item.halgventmod.potash.lore: A white salt leached from wood ash: ash and water in a fermenting barrel. With sand in a glass furnace it makes glass: one potash to two sand.
item.halgventmod.potato_stew.lore: Potatoes boiled in a pot; tastier with onion and salt.
item.halgventmod.potter_clay.lore: Kneaded in a clay barrel. On the potter's wheel it becomes a vessel, in a mould — a brick. Clay left to age three days is better.
item.halgventmod.quilted_aketon.lore: A quilted jacket stuffed with tow or cotton. It softens blows and keeps mail from chafing.
item.halgventmod.quiver.lore: Hangs from the belt. Holds up to 20 arrows; bows and crossbows draw from it first.
item.halgventmod.raw_brick.lore: Moulded from kneaded clay. A wet one dries on a shelf, a dry one is fired in a kiln for a brick — kilns are mended with bricks.
item.halgventmod.raw_bun.lore: E at a fired oven to bake it.
item.halgventmod.raw_dish.lore: Put together at a kitchen table. E at a fired oven to bake it.
item.halgventmod.raw_hide.lore: Freshly taken from the beast. It rots in two days: salt it or flesh it on the beam at once.
item.halgventmod.raw_loom_weight.lore: A lump of kneaded clay pierced with a stick. Dry it on a shelf, fire it in a kiln — a weight for the loom.
item.halgventmod.raw_pie.lore: E at a fired oven to bake it.
item.halgventmod.rawhide.lore: Pelt dried without tanning: stiff, but afraid of water. A small one scraped down gives parchment.
item.halgventmod.rivets.lore: Short iron rivets: they fasten brigandine plates, armour straps and hilt scales.
item.halgventmod.rye.lore: Rye grain. A quern grinds it into rye flour; a pot makes porridge.
item.halgventmod.rye_bread.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.rye_dough.lore: E at a fired oven to bake it into black bread.
item.halgventmod.rye_flour.lore: Ground on a quern. With water at a kitchen table it makes rye dough.
item.halgventmod.rye_seeds.lore: Found in the grass. Right-click farmland to sow.
item.halgventmod.sal_ammoniac.lore: White crystals sublimed from bone. Right-click to sniff: the sharp smell brings you round — it sobers, clears nausea and dark spots.
item.halgventmod.salmon_with_herbs.lore: Baked in an oven with savoury herbs.
item.halgventmod.salo.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.salt.lore: Boiled out of water in a vat over a fire. Keeps hides and goes into the alum bath.
item.halgventmod.salted_hide.lore: Packed with salt, it keeps for half a month. Next: the beam and the vat.
item.halgventmod.salted_meat.lore: Meat from the brine barrel. Keeps long, but salty — makes you thirsty.
item.halgventmod.saw.lore: E at a sawhorse with a log rips it into planks: left click presses on the push stroke, the mouse steers the cut along the line. Pressing on the return stroke jams the saw.
item.halgventmod.scraper.lore: E at a limed hide on the beam scrapes the hair; at small rawhide it scrapes parchment.
item.halgventmod.scythe.lore: Cuts crops three in a row across your view. Every stalk dulls the blade.
item.halgventmod.sherds.lore: Whatever cracked in the kiln or broke. A quern grinds it into grog.
item.halgventmod.shoulder_bag.lore: Worn on the back or at the side.
item.halgventmod.shuttle.lore: E at a loom with its warp set to weave: throw the shuttle while the shed is open and beat the weft in just right. Weft yarn is taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.sickle.lore: Cuts a crop at any stage of growth. An unripe one yields only seeds.
item.halgventmod.silver_goblet.lore: A cast footed goblet, tableware of the nobility. One measure of water or a drink: right-click water to fill, right-click to drink; fill it from a jug, amphora or cask. It doesn't break.
item.halgventmod.silver_ingot.lore: Silver parted from lead on a cupel: the lead burns to litharge and the silver stays as a bright bead. Coins are struck from such ingots.
item.halgventmod.silver_ore.lore: Threads of native silver in quartz, a miner's rare luck. Such ore is smelted straight to silver, without lead.
item.halgventmod.sledgehammer.lore: The striker's sledge. Stand by an anvil where a smith is working and press E with it to strike in time on his marks: heavy work goes twice as fast.
item.halgventmod.smith_hammer.lore: The smith's hand hammer for work at the anvil. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.smith_stamp.lore: A steel punch bearing the maker's own mark, struck when the stamp is forged. In your inventory, right-click it onto a metal piece to mark it: the tooltip will show whose work it is.
item.halgventmod.soft_leather.lore: Alum-tawed suede, thin and supple. For gloves and linings.
item.halgventmod.spear_shaft.lore: Long, slimmer towards the head, with a hole for the socket nail: for a spear, boar spear, halberd. Goes to the smithy.
item.halgventmod.spices.lore: Spices from overseas. With mutton and garlic — an exquisite dish.
item.halgventmod.spindle.lore: Hold right-click to spin fibre from your inventory into yarn.
item.halgventmod.spirit.lore: From a still. Knocks you down fast; with berries, herbs or honey in a fermenting barrel it becomes a tincture.
item.halgventmod.st_johns_wort.lore: Cut from a St John's wort plant. Tea: Resistance I for 60 s.
item.halgventmod.steel_ingot.lore: An iron bar soaked for days in a sealed box of charcoal until it took up carbon. It holds an edge and a temper: blades, armour plates, bodkins.
item.halgventmod.sublimate.lore: A caustic white poison from quicksilver and vitriol. In your inventory, right-click it onto a blade to coat it: four blows poison.
item.halgventmod.sulfur.lore: Yellow lumps of burning sulphur. It is driven out of copper pyrite in a retort; sublimed once more, it becomes flowers of sulphur.
item.halgventmod.sulfur_balm.lore: Spirit on flowers of sulphur. Fire won't take whoever drinks it: Fire Resistance for 3 min.
item.halgventmod.sulfur_flowers.lore: A fine yellow bloom from the walls of the receiver, the 'spirit of sulphur'. Steeped in spirit, it makes sulphur balm.
item.halgventmod.sweet_bun.lore: A rich bun made with honey.
item.halgventmod.sword_grip.lore: The wooden core of a hilt, slotted for the blade's tang; it gets wrapped in leather. Goes to the smithy.
item.halgventmod.tanned_leather.lore: Firm bark-tanned leather: belts, bags, quivers. Boiled in water it becomes hardened leather.
item.halgventmod.theriac.lore: The antidote: spirit with honey on bone ash. Clears poison, wither, food poisoning, nausea and hunger, Regeneration I for 10 s.
item.halgventmod.threads.lore: For sewing at the sewing table. Plain string will do; a skein of linen yarn makes two.
item.halgventmod.thyme.lore: Cut from a thyme plant. Tea: Absorption I for 60 s (extra health).
item.halgventmod.tin_ingot.lore: A soft white metal. Little use on its own, but without it there is no bronze, no pewter ware and no tinned kettles.
item.halgventmod.tin_ore.lore: Dark heavy grains of cassiterite. Tin ore is scarce, so tin, and bronze with it, are dear.
item.halgventmod.tincture.lore: A spirit steeped with berries, herbs or honey. Gentler than a plain spirit.
item.halgventmod.tongs.lore: Hold the glowing workpiece at the anvil. Without tongs you can't take hot iron. Taken from your inventory.
item.halgventmod.tool_handle.lore: A short handle with a collar for a knife, chisel, hammer or file. Goes to the smithy.
item.halgventmod.tow.lore: The short fibre left from combing flax. Stuffing for aketons and quilted pieces.
item.halgventmod.turnip.lore: A peasant's vegetable. With other vegetables in a pot — a vegetable stew. Right-click farmland to plant.
item.halgventmod.vegetable_soup.lore: Vegetables boiled in a pot. Eases both hunger and thirst.
item.halgventmod.venison.lore: A hunter's prize. Risky raw: grill it on the coals.
item.halgventmod.verdigris.lore: Green copper rust: copper left in vinegar. A painter's pigment, and in spirit a wound balm.
item.halgventmod.vinegar.lore: What happens when fermentation goes too long. Better not to drink it.
item.halgventmod.vitriol.lore: Blue crystals settled out of water in which roasted copper ore was soaked. With quicksilver in a retort it makes corrosive sublimate.
item.halgventmod.wet_grain.lore: Hang it on a hook to sprout.
item.halgventmod.wet_leather.lore: Fresh from the vat. Stretch it on the rack and dry it before it spoils.
item.halgventmod.wheat_bread.lore: Hastily skinned and reeking of beast. Until it is dressed, it is good only for the flies.
item.halgventmod.wheat_flour.lore: Ground on a quern. With water at a kitchen table it makes dough.
item.halgventmod.wine.lore: Berry or marsh wine. Better when aged.
item.halgventmod.wool_roving.lore: Combed wool. Spin it into woollen yarn with the spindle.
item.halgventmod.wool_yarn.lore: For the loom, as warp and weft.
item.halgventmod.woolen_cloth.lore: A length off the loom. At the sewing table it becomes cloaks, hoods, chaperons, mittens.
item.halgventmod.wormwood.lore: Cut from a wormwood plant. Bitter tea: clears food poisoning, hunger and poison.
item.halgventmod.wound_balm.lore: Spirit steeped on verdigris. It closes wounds: +2 hearts at once and Regeneration I for 30 s.
item.halgventmod.yarrow.lore: Cut from a yarrow plant. Tea: Regeneration I for 15 s.
item.halgventmod.zinc_ore.lore: A pale zinc ore. Zinc is not smelted from it: calamine is heated with copper in a closed crucible, and the copper turns to brass.
item.minecraft.charcoal.lore: Charcoal burnt in a clamp. Only it gives the heat ore smelting needs; firewood won't do.
item.minecraft.coal.lore: A black burning stone from rare pits. It burns hotter than charcoal but is no good for smelting ore: sulphur makes the iron brittle. Smithies and hearths burn it.
